title: Neural Lifetimes
summary: A library from a payments company for predicting user behaviour from event streams, modelling customer lifetime from transaction sequences. SDV's models are forked in place: `custom_tvae.py` reimplements `TVAESynthesizer` over RDT's `OneHotEncodingTransformer`, `custom_par.py` builds on `sdv.metadata.Table`, and `ctgan` and `rdt` are pinned. The 'custom' prefix marks SDV code adapted rather than called.

title: Fed-TDA
summary: Implementation of Fed-TDA, federated tabular data augmentation for non-IID data distributed across clients. The transform and marginal-fitting layers are SDV's: a hyper-transformer built on RDT's error types and univariate selection taken from copulas, both pinned. The federated coordination is the contribution; the per-client modelling is copula machinery.

title: OCT-GAN
summary: Implementation of OCT-GAN, a neural ODE-based conditional tabular GAN published at WWW 2021. The architecture is CTGAN's with ODE layers substituted in: `OCTGANSynthesizer` mirrors the conditional generator interface and the repository carries its own `TVAESynthesizer` alongside it. A named descendant of CTGAN rather than a user of it.

title: Better Code, Better Science
summary: An open-source book on writing better scientific code with AI assistance. Its validation chapter uses `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` with `Metadata` to manufacture realistic test data, presenting SDV as a software-testing tool for researchers rather than a research subject.

title: Predicting fraudulent crypto transactions
summary: Work on the Elliptic bitcoin transaction dataset, improving on published baselines for illicit-transaction detection. A dedicated script fits `ctgan.CTGANSynthesizer` to rebalance the heavily skewed illicit class. CTGAN is the class-imbalance remedy rather than the object of study.

title: TTVAE
summary: Implementation of TTVAE, a transformer-based generative model for tabular data. SDV appears on both sides: RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder` do the mixed-type encoding the model consumes, and a `baselines/sdv/` directory runs `CopulaGANSynthesizer` for comparison. SDV is both the input pipeline and a measured competitor.

title: clarc
summary: A workflow system for a coding agent, bundling several hundred skills, commands and rule sets. Its privacy-engineering skill packages SDV as the synthesis procedure an agent should follow, with `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `SingleTableMetadata` in the worked pattern. Another instance of SDV encoded as an invocable agent capability.

title: kisehyun STUDY notes
summary: A personal Korean-language study repository covering analytics certification practice, explainability and PyTorch. One notebook exercises `CTGANSynthesizer` through the pre-1.0 `ctgan.synthesizer` path. A single exploratory notebook rather than sustained use.

title: HAMP membership-inference defence
summary: Code for a defence against membership inference attacks that mitigates leakage by suppressing model overconfidence, evaluated across several datasets. CTGAN is vendored twice, under the Location and Texas experiment trees, supplying `CTGANSynthesizer`, `TVAESynthesizer` and RDT's transformers to generate the tabular data the attacks are run against. SDV manufactures the privacy testbed.

title: LEGO-Xtal
summary: A generator for crystal structures guided by local environment geometry, producing candidate materials for computational screening. RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder` do the feature transform, carried over from CTGAN's mixed-type handling into a crystallography setting. The encoding layer travels further from tabular data than the generators do.
affiliations: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

title: fairdo
summary: A package for mitigating bias in tabular datasets by optimising the data itself rather than the model trained on it. SDV supplies the synthetic datasets the fairness methods are exercised on: `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `SingleTableMetadata` are imported in the dataset utilities, with `sdv>=0.17.1` pinned for the evaluation environment. A fairness toolkit using SDV to construct controlled test populations.

title: RFAE: Autoencoding Random Forests
summary: Code reproducing a manuscript on autoencoding random forests, an R package with Python benchmark scripts. `TVAESynthesizer` with `SingleTableMetadata` is run as one of the compression benchmarks. SDV is a comparison arm for a method that otherwise lives in R.

title: Unlocking Information: Synthetic Data for Open Access
summary: Material for a PyCon DE conference talk introducing synthetic tabular data, covering generation and evaluation for open-access publishing. The worked code is SDV: `SingleTableMetadata` and `evaluate_quality` drive the CTGAN example, and `sdv` appears throughout the compiled requirements. A conference-audience introduction built entirely on the library.

title: VAE-BGM tabular data generator
summary: A tabular generator combining a variational autoencoder with a Bayesian Gaussian mixture, evaluated against published alternatives on clinical and census data. SDV serves as both scaffolding and comparison: `SingleTableMetadata` describes the data, SDMetrics' `QualityReport` scores it, and CTGAN output directories are kept per dataset for the state-of-the-art arm.

title: RelDiff
summary: A graph-based diffusion model for generating relational, multi-table data. SDV supplies the surrounding apparatus: `SingleTableMetadata` in preprocessing and SDMetrics' `QualityReport` and `DiagnosticReport` for scoring. A relational method that competes with HMA while measuring itself in SDV's terms.

title: SynEval
summary: An evaluation framework scoring synthetic tabular data on fidelity, utility, diversity and privacy. SDV is a hard dependency, pinned at `sdv>=1.0.0` in the project metadata and resolving RDT, copulas and Faker beneath it; the demo notebook installs and exercises the stack. The framework organises SDV's metric surface into a single report.
needs: near-identical to SCU-TrustworthyAI/SynEval; establish which is canonical and set duplicate_of

title: Population Synthesis
summary: Open-source probabilistic models for population synthesis, generating synthetic households and individuals for reproducible transport and policy simulation. A local copy of CTGAN's data transformer, built on RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder`, sits in the utilities, with `ctgan` and `rdt` pinned. Census-scale population generation resting on CTGAN's encoding.

title: Customer Churn Analytics Platform
summary: An end-to-end analytics platform modelling and visualising customer churn, served through FastAPI. `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` is the synthesis endpoint of the running service, with `sdv==1.16.2` pinned. SDV is deployed in the application path rather than used in exploration.

title: Pedestrian collision prediction
summary: Predicting pedestrian collisions from GeoVex spatial embeddings with a linear classifier. Data preparation generates additional collision records with `CTGANSynthesizer` and `SingleTableMetadata`, since real collisions are rare relative to the road network. CTGAN addresses sparsity in a road-safety dataset.

title: SynEval (SCU TrustworthyAI)
summary: An evaluation framework assessing fidelity, utility, diversity and privacy of synthetic tabular data, pinning `sdv>=1.0.0` and exercising the stack in a demo notebook. The content is near-identical to the privacy-enhancing-technologies copy, so the two record one project under two owners rather than two independent efforts.
needs: establish which SynEval copy is canonical and set duplicate_of on the other

title: Causal-TGAN
summary: Implementation of Causal-TGAN, a tabular GAN that conditions generation on a causal graph over the columns. The dataset layer uses RDT's `OneHotEncodingTransformer`, keeping CTGAN's categorical encoding while replacing its conditional mechanism with causal structure. A named variant in the CTGAN line.

title: AIxChem augmentation
summary: Code accompanying a chemistry paper on machine learning for exploring chemical space, published in JACS. Its augmentation module offers `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer` with `SingleTableMetadata` to expand small reaction datasets, with `ctgan` and `copulas` pinned in the environment. Synthetic data addressing the sample scarcity typical of wet-lab results.

title: Data Analysis and Economic Decisions course
summary: Course pages for a Chinese-language data analysis and economic decision-making module. The machine-learning introduction shows `CTGANSynthesizer` as the tabular synthesis example. A single teaching mention rather than sustained use.

title: synthsonic
summary: A tabular data modelling and synthesis package built on Bayesian networks with reweighting. SDGym is the benchmark it reports against: notebooks load its datasets and the leaderboard tables place synthsonic beside `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer`. A competitor that adopts SDV's benchmark as the common scoreboard.

title: MargCTGAN
summary: Official implementation of MargCTGAN, a modification of CTGAN targeting the low-sample regime by better preserving marginal statistics. CTGAN is vendored under `synthesizers/ctgan/` and re-exported as `CTGANSynthesizer`, TVAE likewise, with `ctgan==0.7.1` and `sdv==1.0.1` pinned and SDMetrics used for scoring. The name states the relationship and the code is a direct modification.

title: Machine Unlearning in Learned Databases
summary: An experimental analysis of machine unlearning in learned database systems, published at SIGMOD 2024. TVAE is one of the learned models whose unlearning behaviour is measured: CTGAN is vendored under `tvae/ctgan/`, `TVAESynthesizer` drives the benchmark, and `rdt==1.0.0` is pinned. SDV's generator stands in for the class of learned models the paper studies.

title: TableGAN-MCA
summary: Code for TableGAN-MCA, evaluating membership collision attacks against GAN-synthesized tabular data. `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer` are named in the README as the victim models the attack is mounted against, with the CTGAN paper cited as their source. SDV's generators are the attack surface under study.

title: MIDST Models
summary: Reference implementations for the MIDST challenge on membership inference against diffusion-based tabular synthesis. SDV is pinned at 1.11.0 and used throughout: `MultiTableMetadata` in the TabDDPM pipeline, SDMetrics' `QualityReport` for density evaluation, copulas resolved beneath. A competition testbed standardised on SDV's metadata and metrics.

title: DP-MERF (author copy)
summary: An implementation of differentially private mean-embedding random features, loading its tabular benchmarks through `sdgym.load_dataset`. The code matches the ParkLabML copy already indexed, so the two record one project under an author and a lab account.
needs: establish which DP-MERF copy is canonical and set duplicate_of on the other

title: Scottish Tax Benefit Model
summary: A microsimulation model of the Scottish fiscal system, computing the effect of tax and benefit changes on household incomes. SDV generates the shareable test population: a synthesis script imports `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, `CTGANSynthesizer`, `TVAESynthesizer` and the multi-table `HMASynthesizer` with `Metadata`, so household relational structure survives into a distributable mini-dataset. Fiscal policy modelling on confidential survey data made publishable through SDV.

title: Synthetic network traffic comparative analysis
summary: A comparison of methods for generating synthetic network traffic, framed as an architectural selection guide and run over intrusion-detection datasets. `TVAESynthesizer` with `SingleTableMetadata` is one of the compared architectures on NSL-KDD. SDV supplies a contender in a security-domain generator bake-off.

title: Exoplanet Quest
summary: A web application built for a NASA Space Apps challenge, classifying exoplanets from NASA archive data and packaging the result as a game. `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` with `Metadata` expands the confirmed-planet catalogue, since real detections are few relative to the model's appetite. An unusual domain for SDV, driven by genuine data scarcity rather than privacy.

title: DualEMobilityData datasets
summary: Open datasets of e-bike and e-scooter trips, published to support micromobility research. The bike dataset is generated rather than collected: a dedicated notebook builds it with `SingleTableMetadata` and validates with `evaluate_quality`. The published data is SDV output, and its fidelity claim rests on SDV's own report.

title: ASI: AI solution architectures course
summary: Polish-language course material on AI solution architectures and deployment methodologies, with several student project templates. SDV recurs across those projects: `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `SingleTableMetadata` in one test harness, `sdv==1.9.0` pinned in another environment, `ctgan` and `copulas` in a tracked experiment run. SDV as a standard component of an MLOps teaching pipeline.
evidence: 7_project_examples/Delta/src/tester.py:7,13; Epsilon/environment.yml (sdv==1.9.0); Gamma wandb run requirements (ctgan==0.8.0, copulas==0.9.2)

title: TabNet architectures research
summary: A Russian-language bachelor's thesis investigating neural architectures for tabular data. Augmentation is done with the pre-1.0 `sdv.tabular` CTGAN and TVAE classes, scored with `sdv.evaluation`, and `sdv==0.14.0` is pinned. SDV supplies both the augmentation and the objective the thesis optimises against.

title: ConDOR
summary: Official code for ConDOR, a conditional diffusion model with ordinal regression for generating longitudinal data in neurodegenerative disease studies, published at ICLR 2025. Its baselines directory is a copy of tab-ddpm's vendored CTGAN tree, including `train_sample_tvae.py` and the `rdt==0.6.4` pin. The baseline arrangement was inherited wholesale from an earlier paper rather than assembled here.
evidence: baselines/CTGAN/train_sample_tvae.py:5; baselines/requirements.txt (rdt==0.6.4); tree identical to yandex-research/tab-ddpm's CTGAN/

title: Adversarial Random Forests paper code
summary: Code reproducing the adversarial random forests paper on density estimation and generative modelling. SDV appears across the benchmark suite: the pre-1.0 `sdv.tabular` CTGAN and TVAE for image-adjacent experiments, `sdgym.datasets.load_dataset` for runtime comparison, and `CTGANSynthesizer` in the real-data arm. A tree-based method benchmarked throughout against SDV's neural generators.

title: TabPC
summary: Code for a critical assessment of tabular data generation via probabilistic circuits, arguing that reported gains are smaller than claimed. Its metrics module is SDV's: `SingleTableMetadata` plus SDMetrics' `QualityReport`, with `sdmetrics==0.24.0` and `sdv` pinned. A paper questioning the field's evaluation practice while adopting SDV's metrics as the standard.

title: BikeBench
summary: A benchmark environment for evaluating generative models on bicycle frame design, scoring candidates against engineering objectives and constraints. `CTGANSynthesizer` with `Metadata` generates designs in the embedding pipeline, and per-model result directories keep CTGAN's outputs. SDV competing in engineering design rather than record synthesis.
